title: Applicationfunction accesses Dataobject
description: The application function reads, creates or modifies the state held in the data object while it performs its work, treating it as passive material: a domain object that keeps its own state consistent (a value object or an aggregate held in memory), or data with no declared shape. Use accesses to a data-model object schema instead when the value is held to a declared shape: an interface, record, struct, dataclass or DTO of only fields, or a persisted entity.
x-dr-evidence: The function's implementing methods construct, call the state methods of, or mutate a domain object (a value object or an aggregate held in memory), for example by taking it as a parameter or returning it; or they take or return a value typed any, object, dict or Map<string, unknown>, or a parsed JSON value, that no interface, type or schema declares.
